model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for three different models or configurations. The x-axis represents the number of completions in thousands, labeled as "Number of completions (k)", with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1 on the logarithmic scale, showing values from 1 to 256. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage", with a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three lines: one in blue with circle markers and a solid line style representing Llama-3B, one in green with triangle markers and a solid line style representing Llama-1B, and one in light blue with triangle markers and a dashed line style representing Llama-1B + FT. The Llama-3B line starts at approximately (1, 0.45) and ends at (256, 0.85), showing a steady increase. The Llama-1B line starts at approximately (1, 0.4) and ends at (256, 0.85), also showing a steady increase. The Llama-1B + FT line starts at approximately (1, 0.55) and ends at (256, 0.85), similarly showing a steady increase.
